name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections built on native <details> and <summary>, with an animated open and close.

classes.name: accordion
classes.description: Wraps a group of <details> elements. Give the <details> the same name attribute to allow only one open at a time.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Native attribute. Sections that share a name form an exclusive group, so opening one closes the others.

attributes.name: aria-disabled="true"
attributes.description: Dims the summary and blocks pointer interaction.

notes: No JavaScript is needed. The open/close animation uses ::details-content and interpolate-size, so browsers without them simply open instantly.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Only one section can be open at a time because every <details> shares the same name.

examples.title: Multiple
examples.description: Leave out the name attribute to let several sections stay open.
